name: Arianna Grace
profileSummary: Bianca Sophia Carelli is a Canadian-American professional wrestler and beauty pageant competitor. She is signed to WWE, where she performs under the ring name Arianna Grace on the NXT brand and is a member of the BirthRight stable. She also appears in WWE partner promotion Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), where she is a former one-time TNA Knockouts World Champion.
